maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly from producing new debit, credit and prepaid cards for banks and fintechs, plus issuance software, not servicing installed base.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are banks, credit unions, fintechs and retailers paying for card production and issuance; revenue comes from private-sector payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through card production, instant issuance and prepaid programs; acquisitions such as Rippleshot fraud tools are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Secure card production, Card@Once instant issuance and wallet provisioning integrate with issuers' processors and cores; switching needs re-integration and certification.
